shields_note: Posted under 'Defensive Shield' outside the 60; all ten are named.
notes: The description says the deck won a local tournament about two weeks before posting; no event is named.

No separate starting section was posted. The strategy says the objective's Theed Palace Generator and Generator Core are started, with An Unusual Amount Of Fear for the shields; the author says he starts 'only' a The Signal (to get Goo Nee Tay, or Honor Of The Jedi against Court) instead of three Alter-immune Effects. No starting interrupt is set. All of these count toward the 60.
The strategy lists We Wish To Board At Once as (2x) and The Signal as a single card; the card list (1 and 2) is kept as published.

Posted 'Twass Khaa' dested Tawss Khaa; 'Projections Of A Skywalker' dested Projection Of A Skywalker; 'Lando Calrissian, Scroundrel' dested Lando Calrissian, Scoundrel; 'Run Luke, Run' dested Run Luke, Run!.
Chewie, Enraged, Lando Calrissian, Scoundrel, Mindful Of The Future, Run Luke, Run! and The Signal dested the original Decipher printings, not later Virtual cards.
The Defensive Shields dested the Reflections III shield printings where an older Effect shares the name ('Wise Advise' = Wise Advice).
